title.narrative: GC7: Scaling Up Malaria Prevention, Treatment, and Control Interventions in Liberia for Sustained Impact. - Liberia (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Liberia, Malaria, Catholic Relief Services - United States Conference of Catholic Bishops (CRS Liberia)This program has the following goals: To reduce malaria incidence and deaths by at least 80 percent of the 2016 (45% prevalence) levels by 2027 (9% prevalence) - MTR Report (2023). The objectives of this program are: By end of 2027, reduce malaria mortality rates by at least 89.5% (18/100,000 population) compared to 2016 (172/100,000 population). By end of 2027, reduce malaria case incidence by at least 80% (76/1,000 population) compared to 2016 (380/1,000 population). By end of 2027, promote and maintain a culture of evidence-based decision making to achieve malaria program performance at all levels. By the end of 2027, strengthen and maintain capacity for program management, coordination and partnership to achieve malaria program performance at all levels
